analysis.purpose: The Go extractor: turns one Go file into symbol nodes (func, method, struct, interface, typedef, typealias, including interface methods as nested symbols) with qualified names, spans and signatures, plus member-of edges and intra-file call edges — never resolving anything across file boundaries.
responsibilities: Emit a symbol per declaration with qualifiedName, span and signature
Emit member-of edges linking each symbol to its enclosing symbol or file
Emit calls edges only where the callee resolves inside the same file
Stay deterministic and offline so a cold install needs no network

businessRules.rule: The extractor never guesses across files; cross-file resolution is the resolver phase job.
businessRules.rationale: Capability honesty — a guess made here would be indistinguishable from a fact downstream.

businessRules.rule: Engine: a hand-rolled tokenizer and structural parser, pure JavaScript and deterministic.
businessRules.rationale: Determinism is what makes re-indexing byte-stable and installs offline.
